LanguageData.CC_Settings_IllnessBudget: Serious illness shares the game's own rate
LanguageData.CC_Settings_IllnessBudget_Tip: Rimfolk's serious illnesses and the game's own diseases draw on one clock, so in all serious illness comes about as often as in plain RimWorld, and some of the cases are Rimfolk's kinds. Each serious illness of Rimfolk's that starts holds back the next of the game's own diseases the storyteller sends to that home. Once the game's own has come, Rimfolk's wait 30 days there, and at most about half the cases are Rimfolk's, so the game's own still come. Crowding and dirt bring more of the kinds that go round and spread between roommates, not more in all. Left alone: a quest's outbreak, food poisoning, wound infections, animal diseases and other mods' sicknesses filed outside the game's disease category. The news says when one is held back or a case of Rimfolk's put off. Needs the deeper game hooks. Turned off, Rimfolk's serious illnesses come on top of the game's own, as before.
LanguageData.CC_SetNote_IllnessBudget: Rimfolk's serious illnesses take the place of some of the game's own, not more in all.
LanguageData.CC_Adv_Sickness_DetailShared: More of the serious illness that comes here is the kind that goes round, about {0} times as much as in a well-kept colony: {1}. It comes no more often in all, since Rimfolk's serious illnesses share the game's own rate, but these spread between roommates. Beds of their own and a clean kitchen bring it down.
